pages.title: Alpine Ibex
pages.text: The Alpine ibex ($(o)Capra ibex$()) is a wild goat of the European Alps, living on steep slopes above the tree line.$(br2)Males carry huge, backswept horns marked with raised ridges, which they use in clashes during the rut.$(br2)Ibex are astonishing climbers, able to stand on near-vertical rock faces and even on dam walls.
